launches.title: Kater: Ask data questions in plain English
launches.tagline: Drive business outcomes with an AI analyst that organizes, understands, and remembers all the nuances of your company's data.
launches.body:
# TL;DR

Instead of Slacking the data team and waiting 4 days for an answer, use [Kater](https://www.kater.ai) to get the answer in 30 seconds. We make it possible for executives to understand **why** business outcomes occur, and even alert them **before** the outcomes happen again.

### 👋 Hey Everyone

We’re [Yvonne](https://linkedin.com/in/yvonne-chou) and [Robin](https://linkedin.com/in/robin-seitz-12029970). We have over 9 years working in data teams for companies like Microsoft, Kaiser Permanente, Crexi, and Abbott. 

![Image preview](https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/D5622AQGHB0qqGa37Lw/feedshare-shrink_800/0/1706126655985?e=1714608000&v=beta&t=A02VD99wTGip0YSLOWtEg55JqcFoX8mbfK3Tu-PUryU)

As data people, **80%-90% of our time** was dedicated to low-level data requests. When really, the true business value of data comes from answering the **“why”** questions.

That’s why we started [kater.ai](http://kater.ai) — we are committed to automating these low-level questions, and empowering everyone in a company to answer “why” business outcomes occur. **These are the million dollar questions that fundamentally change how businesses operate, and ones they’ve historically never been able to address.**

### 🤔 Why Can’t Companies Answer “Why” Questions?

**The existing enterprise data operation workflow is unscalable.**

1. Data teams receive **10-15** adhoc requests per day
2. Companies spend on average **$10.5 million/year** in data analyst salaries
3. Data is extremely **messy**

### 👨‍💼📊 Meet Butler: Your AI Data Agent

**The solution:**

Butler is an AI agent that organizes the chaos of data.

We found a new way to **auto-document your data team’s tribal knowledge through generating a data map.** Butler indexes and searches the data map using a AgentMesh Framework.

**Butler helps generate hypotheses, writes the queries to validate those hypotheses, and finds any insights from the queries.**

### 🧠 Butler Continuously Learns

We use a combination of RAG and GenAI to capture any feedback users give to support future context for Butler.

![butler](https://docs.kater.ai/assets/images/waiter-6e843699197199c6685ab6d5c536f743.png)

[A 30-second Demo:](https://youtu.be/hiF-F0W61Dw)

### 🔗 The Set Up Process:

1. Simply **connect** Kater’s website to your data warehouse.
2. We’ll **auto-generate descriptions** for all your tables and columns, and immediately start building the **data map** for you.
3. After you verify the data map is correct, in **less than 10 minutes**, you can start asking questions about your data and training Butler.

### 🙏 Our Ask

We currently support connections with Snowflake, Bigquery, and Microsoft SQL Server. If you have any of these (of even if you don’t, we can build a connector in 1 hour) and want to be able to query your data using English, reach out to us at [support@kater.ai](mailto:support@kater.ai)!

* Why do some ads work and others don’t?

launches.tagline: We help service businesses win local search on ChatGPT & other LLMs
launches.body:
Hey there!

We’re [Dylan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dylan-allen/) and [Amadeus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amadeus-peterson/), the founders of [Cheers](https://www.cheers.tech).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93185&key=user_uploads/1314282/4f3b1be6-d50c-4917-a18c-279469925471)

### TL;DR

**TL;DR** AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini) are changing how customers find local services. Soon, they will be booking appointments and buying on our behalf. AI recommends based on **reputation, not ads**. This shift is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).

Cheers is the full-stack GEO platform for service businesses. We ensure AI recommends you first. We analyze your reputation, build a strategy, and turn your frontline employees into a reputation engine—capturing reviews at the point of service and attributing every outcome to the individual employee.

**Ask:** Know a multi-location service business (home services, retail, field sales)? Intro us: [dylan@cheers.tech](mailto:dylan@cheers.tech) (10% referral bonus for closed deals!)

### **Video:**

https://youtu.be/P42T7HQSncA

# 

# The Problem: The End of Local Search As We Know It

Local search is dying. Consumers are moving away from traditional Google searches and asking AI assistants for recommendations. Soon, AI will move from recommendation to action—booking and buying directly.

This is the era of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it changes the rules:

* **You Can't Buy Ads on ChatGPT (yet):** You can pay to be at the top of a Google search, but you can't pay to be suggested by ChatGPT. AIs ignore ad budgets and analyze authentic reputation signals (reviews, citations, social proof).
* **Reputation is Everything:** If the AI cannot find strong, verifiable evidence of your quality, your business is invisible.
* **The Execution Gap:** Most service businesses generate goodwill face-to-face but fail to systematically capture it on the 3rd party sites AI trusts.
* **The Attribution Gap:** Even when they get reviews, they lack attribution. Managers can't see which employees are driving their reputation, so they can’t scale what works.

You can’t win GEO if you don’t generate the right signals, and you can’t optimize the signals if you can't attribute them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93185&key=user_uploads/1314282/818afe3b-2ce0-4f37-8696-cd0e783ee073)

# Our Solution: The Full-Stack GEO Platform

Cheers is the platform built natively for GEO. We help businesses generate the reputation signals that AIs trust and attribute those signals to the people who create them.

Here’s the platform:

1. **Analysis & Strategy:** We analyze a company’s existing online reputation and build a custom GEO optimization plan (covering the reviews, citations, and evidence hubs that AIs parse confidently).
2. **The Reputation Engine (Execution):** We equip frontline employees with ultra-low-friction tools (like NFC taps) to capture reviews and social proof right at the point of service. We route these to the 3rd party sites AI actually cites.
3. **Employee-Level Attribution (The Key):** We attribute every review and referral back to the specific employee and location. Managers can see what behaviors drive growth—and coach, reward, and scale them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93185&key=user_uploads/1314282/951ec0e5-9b68-47e4-9489-b6c7374e7172)

**Traction & Proof** The demand for GEO is exploding. **Cheers has grown 115% in the last 40 days.**

Our methodology is proven at enterprise scale. [Vivint Smart Home](https://vivint.com/) used Cheers to operationalize their reputation strategy across 400 locations.

The results: **70,000+ new 5-star reviews in 5 months.** Vivint now dominates AI recommendations for smart home services in all their service areas. 🤯

# **The Team:**

We've been friends for more than 5 years, and moved from Utah to San Francisco to make Cheers into a decacorn.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93185&key=user_uploads/1314282/009f2142-052e-4699-9b7a-6c988c72e5a8)

[**Dylan Allen**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dylan-allen/) (CEO) is a technical founder who's worked in experience/reputation management across [Podium](https://www.podium.com/) (YC W16), [Weave](https://www.getweave.com/) (YC W14), and [Microsoft Azure](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/) before starting Cheers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93185&key=user_uploads/1314282/c1ef80dd-107f-486d-9edb-03aec637cf6c)

[**Amadeus Peterson**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amadeus-peterson/) (CTO) was a software engineer at [Northrop Grumman](https://www.northropgrumman.com/) working on the Sentinel Missile system before Dylan convinced him to quit and move to SF.

**Our Ask:** Do you know anyone at a multi-location service business (Home Services, Field Sales, Retail, Hospitality)? PE rollups are also a great fit.

Email [dylan@cheers.tech](mailto:dylan@cheers.tech) with an intro → We offer a 10% referral bonus on the annual contract value of any closed deal.

launches.title: Cheers: The super-app for in-person employees
launches.tagline: Meet Cheers, the all-in-one platform for in-person employee excellence.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’re [Cheers](https://cheers.tech), building the super-app for in-person employees (think home services, restaurants, D2D sales). We’re starting with NFC-enabled employee badges that make key tasks—like collecting reviews and verifying employment—seamless. It’s our first step toward becoming the central platform for in-person work.

# **🥂 What is Cheers?**

_Cheers is on a mission to revolutionize how in-person employees work._ We’re building the super-app that will become the central hub for everything these employees need—from managing schedules and tracking performance to accepting tips and capturing customer feedback—all through NFC technology pre-enabled on smartphones today.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83053&key=user_uploads/1314282/43a513ab-a934-4a14-a112-05fa155cc8a3)

# **🧨 The Problem We Solve:**

**In-person customer and employee interactions are often inefficient and filled with friction.** Whether it’s collecting feedback, verifying employment, or capturing leads, these processes are typically slow, manual, and prone to errors. This inefficiency not only frustrates employees and customers _but also leads to missed opportunities for businesses to optimize and grow._

Check out how it looks here: <https://youtu.be/yfW_QonAPEE>

**Cheers aims to make every in-person interaction seamless, frictionless, and measurable.** We’re starting with NFC-enabled employee badges that go beyond basic identification. These badges enable employees to perform key actions with just a tap—whether it’s gathering a 5-star Google Review, collecting a lead, or verifying employment—right when it matters most, face-to-face with the customer.

# 

# **🚀 Why We’re Excited About Cheers:**

We believe that these badges are our wedge into businesses. They address immediate needs (better Google Reviews, etc.) while laying the groundwork for something much bigger. **As employees and owners tap into Cheers’ early features, they quickly see the value in capturing and attributing customer interactions to individual employees.** That means the right employees get the proper credit and feedback, which is actionable at a more granular level. We’ve already seen this open the door to deeper integration across operations. _(**also, Apple** made an announcement about **iOS 18.1** that really excites us, check it out _[_here_](https://9to5mac.com/2024/08/14/apple-nfc-chip-iphone-ios-18-1/)_.)_

**Example:** Imagine an employee tapping their badge to allow a customer to leave a 5-star Google Review in just 3 taps: notification, rating, post. Or, picture a customizable employee page where customers can perform multiple actions—like booking services or leaving feedback—all in one place.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83053&key=user_uploads/1314282/0777f19c-8ae1-41f0-8d8e-c09eaa28b4e5)

# **📈 Our Traction:**

We have 25 customers, the majority of which are small businesses, like your local bridal shop or burger joint. We have one enterprise-level client with whom we’ve been running a successful paid pilot for the past 2 months. **We’ve grown our MRR from \~$1,400 on July 1st to \~$4,000 now.** Cheers has already processed over 3,000 internal and external reviews for our customers. 

Our reporting software is delivering real results—**our average customer has 5-10x’ed their monthly 5-star Google Reviews.** Managers are using it to track performance, run competitions, and provide targeted feedback. **(See the screenshot below for a look at what our customers do when hosting competitions).**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83053&key=user_uploads/1314282/c932da5c-dd75-4579-ab20-080c058000e3)

**But this is just the start.** We’re building Cheers to be the central operating system for in-person businesses—a platform that will transform how in-person teams operate, from scheduling and payments to customer engagement and beyond.

# **🙏 Our Ask to You:**

We’re looking for intros to folks who manage—or know someone who manages—in-person, customer-facing teams: anything from self-storage to solar sales. Cheers is _especially_ helpful for companies that currently struggle with getting online reviews (Google, TripAdvisor, Thumbtack, etc.).

Our first product, the Cheers NFC-enabled employee badge, is already delivering strong results, and with your help, we can build something truly impactful. Request a text from one of us, or schedule a call with our CEO Dylan, [here](https://cheers.tech/get-started).

And finally, a toast, to people like you. Cheers! 🥂

name: Bayesline
long_description:
Bayesline is building a GPU-powered financial analytics suite for institutional investors, like hedge funds. 

Clients use our cloud deployed solution to build custom analytics in seconds, having previously been frustrated with off the shelf solutions that don't generate any alpha. What used to take weeks or months now happens near instantly. 

Sebastian, CFA (ex Bloomberg Quant & AI Research) and Misha, PhD (ex BlackRock Managing Director) met while working at BlackRock in 2016. With a combined 20 years of experience in the space they set out to change the way the industry uses analytics - from one size doesn't fit all to truly tailored to clients' needs.
one_liner: Highly customizable and blazingly fast analytics for asset managers.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: We met in 2016 at BlackRock, and lived together during Covid. We both have a very strong mission to revolutionize financial analytics. We thought that the world’s most renowned institutions would be the best place to do that. But it turns out that they move too slowly and are not ready to truly innovate, especially in the age of AI. Leaving our lucrative careers was the only way to pursue our dreams.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: All of financial analytics was built in the 90s on fundamentally an outdated tech stack (C++ on CPUs). The AI community has developed a new stack (Python ML packages on GPUs) that is orders of magnitude faster, both in time-to-market and run-time. Our aim is to rebuild all of financial analytics on this stack; from economic scenario simulation engines for banks and insurers to portfolio risk models for hedge funds. In the future, Bayesline will be integrated in all financial institutions, eliminating the days of waiting for calculation that tens of thousands of industry professionals have to deal with.

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

MinusX is a Chrome Extension that adds a side chat to Jupyter and Metabase. Given an instruction, our agent operates the apps— via clicking and typing— to analyze data and answer queries. We strongly believe that you already have all the tools you need; you just need someone like MinusX to use them! Checkout [**minusx.ai**](http://minusx.ai) for more info.

<https://youtu.be/lcO9XGofW40>

# **Asks**

1. Install our [**Chrome extension**](https://minusx.ai/chrome-extension).
2. Take MinusX for a spin in our [**playground**](https://minusx.ai/playground)!
3. We’re working on supporting more tools. Want us to hurry up, or don't see your favorite tool in our list? Here’s a [**google form**](https://minusx.ai/tool-request) you can fill out so that we can notify you when we support your tool!

# **Features**

### 1\. Generate Hypotheses and Explore data

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82787&key=user_uploads/164724/53f4faaf-4dae-4226-9037-4142ffea5462)

### 2\. Interop with MinusX to modify existing Jupyter notebooks or Metabase Questions

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82787&key=user_uploads/164724/259d0be2-0f20-4440-90af-84cae7297264)

### 3\. Select a region and ask questions, or ask for modifications

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82787&key=user_uploads/164724/40ed2aeb-29c3-42c8-9e9b-3b1d96b866ae)

# **Pain**

* Lack of data analyst/data scientist bandwidth is a certified pain.
* If you’re a programmer, you just want answers. If you’re a product manager, you just want answers. If you’re an analyst/scientist, you want 10 clones of yourself.
* Any new fancy “talk-to-data” platform is a whole thing. You have to migrate your data, and you have to convince your whole team to move— just to start using it.
* Working in ChatGPT / Claude requires constant copy-pasting. Also, you want to inter-operate with AI, make corrections when it messes up, and guide it rather than just admonish it in chat.
* More importantly, they’re still just chat! No AI system today can really use analytics software - click and type - to get you that data you needed 5 minutes ago.

# **Our Approach**

> ### **_An AI Data Scientist is a Scientist, not yet-another-new-analytics-platform_**

* Advanced agents should just work with tools you already use and get out of the way.
* MinusX integrates seamlessly into workflows. You can invoke it only when you need it to do something.
* Whether you’re a data analyst, programmer, or product manager, you can use MinusX to speed up your workflows instantly.
* We believe the path to advanced agents runs through specialized, useful intermediaries.

# **Team**

launches.title: Solar: An infinite canvas for vibe-coding production apps
launches.tagline: We build the most complicated full-stack apps, faster than anywhere else.
launches.body:
## TL;DR

Solar lets small teams collaborate with AI agents to build and deploy production apps in minutes. Like Figma, but no mockups—just real software with live data and backend Python functionality. Built by our full-stack AI agent, powered by your imagination.

https://youtu.be/Gl03z0M8BWk

## Why this, and why us?

Hi everyone! We’re Vivek, Dan, John, and Ziray: the team behind [Lumenary](http://www.lumenary.com). We met each other during our first few weeks at Dartmouth and have been best friends ever since. We’ve lived together, worked together, traveled the world together, and have even summited some notable peaks together (don’t ask about Mount Shasta).

Our team brings together engineering from Palantir, Jane Street, IMC Trading, and Flatiron Health. We’ve built enterprise-grade AI products, a capital allocation system that controls billions, a data engine that processes petabytes–we _all_ build and deploy software _quickly_ in contexts _where it cannot fail_.

Solar began as an internal tool that we used to ship enterprise demos faster than any tool on the market. We decided to productize and focus on Solar completely.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/0e7139b1-e4ab-4818-b5c5-040e6c1e6d37)

## The Problem

We’re a team of four engineers who’ve used nearly every AI-powered app builder. Projects started off great, but we found ourselves in an endless loop of “revert, and try again.” Most of our time was spent waiting and hoping as the LLM made changes one-at-a-time.

Even when the app seemed to work, it was unclear what were real features versus frontend demoware. We lacked an understanding of the architecture, dataflow, and what vulnerabilities were left open. It felt like these platforms had prioritized making neat frontends and bolted on real functionality as an afterthought.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/f231fdfb-a63c-4006-a269-db8dd2df2376)

## What we do

We loved three things:

* Figma’s flexibility — work on many designs with many people
* Cursor’s power — write production code with LLMs
* Retool’s safety — ship apps that you know work

We combined those to make Solar.

Solar’s AI agents collaborate alongside you on a multiplayer canvas. You can see the relationships and data flow between database tables, backend Python logic, and frontend pages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/12b01a63-bcd6-430d-bb33-4b274d542423)

Solar makes apps production-worthy by combining LLM-generated code with deterministic code generation for databases, services, and authentication. This makes your apps maintainable and deployable past the MVP, and able to integrate nicely with existing infrastructure.

We’re the most agentic platform on the market: Solar will read logs, interact with your application, and work for minutes or even hours unattended to get it perfect.

## Our Ask

Sign up at https://solarapp.dev and try building an app.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
For years we worked side by side at Palantir, building with some of the largest industrial companies on the continent. Leopold led the established customer business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Marvin owned and deployed the first instances of what became the Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP). Together we shipped projects that turned into more than €50M in new revenue.

In summer 2024 we left. We had seen what forward-deployed engineers do for large enterprises, and one thing kept showing up: the people who actually run a business, the heads of controlling, the buyers, the plant managers, are still moving data by hand. The signal sits in the ERP, in the CRM, and in a dozen tools that do not talk to each other. So decisions get made in spreadsheets and on gut feel. The gap between the two is where companies lose time, money and confidence.

With today’s frontier models that work can finally be done at software scale. So we are building the autonomous data engineer for the mid-market. ZeitMind connects SAP, your ERP, CRM, HR systems and 600+ other sources, prepares the messy data, and turns everyday business questions into live dashboards, reports and applications, all in natural language.

We joined Y Combinator in S24, put it in front of real controlling, procurement and supply chain teams, and went from zero to €1M ARR in twelve months with six people, customers live in weeks and no IT support needed. Today we are 12 engineers, builders and operators across Munich and London.

launches.body:
### **🏆 TLDR**

[Zeit AI](https://www.zeit-ai.com/) is ChatGPT for enterprise tables. You can sync tables from your data bases, ERP systems, CRMs, CSVs and more. Atop of these tables, simple questions in natural language can be used to locate data, combine it, generate analyses, or even charts. All results are repeatable and explainable. They can be exported at the click of a button. [Watch our demo!](https://youtu.be/u3NcYh4zCz4)

# 🧑‍💻🌟 **The Team**

Together, [Marvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mcbornstein/) and [Leopold](https://www.linkedin.com/in/v-waldthausen/) have over 15 years of combined experience in data engineering and analytics. During our four years side-by-side at Palantir, we led high-impact projects, building an AI rule-engine and generating over €50 million in novel project revenue. We saw first-hand how corporates heavily relied on Excel files, leading to manual work to analyse and combine data. A solution like Zeit AI would have been a game-changer in accessing this data at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83344&key=user_uploads/1927760/4024d05f-c883-4ea7-8053-a6e3eb0fdf7b)

# ⚠️ **Problem**

Non-technical users find it challenging to access and analyse enterprise data. Yet, making data-driven decisions is crucial in today’s fast-paced world.

1. Data is stored in files rather than structured databases.
2. Databases cannot be accessed by non-technical users.
3. Data often needs to be exported and manually combined in Excel.

# 💡 **Solution**

Zeit AI allows non-technical users to derive ad-hoc insights from tables using natural language. This is possible in just three steps.

1. Sync data files directly from your source systems (We support data bases, ERP, CRM and even CSV uploads).
2. A structured cloud database is instantly generated and ready to be explored.
3. Use natural language to seamlessly derive insights from the data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83344&key=user_uploads/1927760/e6ce9c09-e77a-419e-8fae-adda888b1612)

# 🛠️ **How Zeit AI is Used Today**

**Procurement** 🛒 Gaining the upper hand during negotiations by having ad-hoc access to all historical procurement data.

**Consulting** 🗂️ Rapidly explore and analyse data rooms and client files using natural language to confidently deliver value to clients.

**Controlling** 📊 Access extracts from accounting systems and seamlessly combine them with files across departments for comprehensive financial control.

# ✅ **Ask**

[Book a slot](https://calendly.com/leopoldwaldthausen/deploy-zeit-ai) with us to explore using Zeit AI. Refer us to procurement managers and senior consultants. ([founders@zeit-ai.com](mailto:founders@zeit-ai.com))

Get on a [30-minute call](https://calendly.com/leopoldwaldthausen/zeit-ai-demo-booking) with us for a live demo or free office hours for anyone struggling to easily access tabular data at scale.

# **tldr; Fast-track your robotics development**

At [**Ember**](https://www.emberrobotics.com/), we make it easy for robotics teams to catch and fix issues fast. Our edge-first robot diagnostics platform helps you stay on top of system performance—whether you're prototyping, scaling, or deploying in the field. \
\
With instant insights and built-in reliability, we help you move faster, build smarter, and launch with confidence. Ready to try it out? Book a demo [**here**](https://www.emberrobotics.com/) or reach out to us at [**founders@emberrobotics.com**](mailto:founders@emberrobotics.com)!

# **The problem**

1. **No Visibility in Low-Network Zones** – When robots lose connectivity, **cloud-based diagnostics fail**, making it hard to track performance or troubleshoot failures in real time.
2. **Slow, Costly Root-Cause Analysis** – Debugging is painful, with teams sifting through **dense logs and complex graphs** instead of getting clear, actionable insights.
3. **Inefficient DIY Monitoring Stacks** – Robotics teams **waste months building custom diagnostics** because existing tools don’t work for their needs.
4. **Reactive Debugging Leads to System Failures** – Without **proactive monitoring**, small issues snowball into major downtime and expensive repairs.

# **Our solution**

### **🌐 Works Offline**

* **Edge-first diagnostics** to store and analyze data even when the network is down.
* **Smart caching & prioritized sync** ensure no critical insights are lost.

### **🔍 Faster, Clearer Troubleshooting**

* **Instant anomaly detection** surfaces failures before they escalate.
* **Real-time sensor & system health analytics** (cameras, IMU, LiDAR, CPU, memory).
* No more digging through logs—just **straightforward insights** when you need them.

### **⚡ Seamless Integrations**

* **Built-in Sensor Plugins & Robotics Middleware Support** – Off-the-shelf support for **Intel® RealSense™, Luxonis®, Orbbec®**, and more. Easy integrations for **ROS and e-Cal** —no extra setup required.
* **Deploy in minutes with standard Linux packages**—skip the custom integrations.
* **API-first design** lets you access diagnostics effortlessly and extend with your own **custom metrics plugins**.

### **📈 Scale up to Fleet-Wide Monitoring**

* Grow reliably from 1 to 10,000 robots with **consistent, structured data collection**.
* Identify **trends & patterns across groups of sensors and devices**.
* Works in **low-bandwidth environments**, ensuring continuous insights.

Team Intryc (S24) here and excited to show you the second and most upgraded iteration of our product, already used by billion dollar companies like [Deel.com](http://Deel.com) and Blueground as well as hypergrowth startups like Fyxer AI and Factorial.

| The Team |

For those who don’t know us yet, our team spent 8+ years in the CX space. We’ve solved support tickets, managed accounts, built cross-country/continent teams and created entire playbooks and processes of how world-class CX teams should interact and support customers across the globe in our previous employers at Revolut, Confluent, Navan, Meta, Amazon.

| The Problem |

Creating a culture of operational excellence, overachieving, and top performance is one of the toughest challenges every company and leadership team face.

Especially in CX, every customer interaction can make or break that customer trust and turn into a nightmare or opportunity. There’s two sides to this problem. Lack of visibility and time to action.

We solved the first half during our S24 batch when we released our AI QA tool for CX teams that allows companies to monitor up to 100% and the most important samples of their customer interactions. Moving onto the second half, CX and Learning & Development managers spend 15+ hours per week building performance improvement material, aligning resources, and ensuring agents, CSMs, and adjacent CS Ops teams are well trained and prepared. Through role plays, shadowing, piecing together training material, reiterating, and updating the relevant resources - all critical activities yet still remain highly manual, unscalable, and more often than not outdated and simplistic. 2 out of 3 customers churn after a single negative support interaction. Training and coaching is more often than not limited, reactive, time-consuming, and inconsistent.

| The Solution |

Realistic Simulations: Agents practise on challenging, real-life scenarios (based on past tickets) in a safe environment. Low stakes, high gains!

Automated Scoring: Every interaction is measured against your org’s policies & playbooks, with unlimited tries and clear graduation paths. No more guesswork, team members get instant and clear feedback.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/db13b953-549f-4336-95a6-c394e5de273b)

Targeted Coaching: Managers instantly see who needs help and where, cutting wasted training time. Enough with one-size fits all, different people need help in different areas.\
\
Always Improving: Both new joiners and seasoned agents keep up-to-date with new products or processes effortlessly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/68f1a2c1-1c0f-4b44-833b-4c4533e2d3a6)

Continuous monitoring and process improvement: All data points are collected in personalised dashboards and reports that create a virtuous cycle of improvement across the team while completely eliminating up to 80% of manual preparation work and continuous manual data gathering and reporting across the organisation. Systems over wishful thinking.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/3a7b12dc-7bf0-4904-9e84-ed0a38cd5517)

The first results on our early adopters show onboarding and training time reduced by up to 50%. Managers reclaim 12–15 hours per week.

Agents have a lot more visibility on their performance progress, don’t have to guess any more and continuously improve like having a personal coach in their pocket.

We’re excited for as many of you as possible to give this a try and share your feedback!

Upvote our launch here: [https://www.producthunt.com/products/intryc?launch=intryc](https://www.producthunt.com/products/intryc?launch=intryc%5C)\
Thank you all for your support!

launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Alex, George, and Dimi!

We are ex-Meta, Amazon, Revolut, and Confluent engineering and GTM folk who have spent more than 7 years improving the customer experience in companies like Meta, Amazon, Revolut, Confluent, and Navan. We decided to build Intryc with the mission to centralize and automate the repetitive, error-prone, and manual tasks in the Support QA process to free up the time of CX teams so they can focus on what really matters to them - their customers and business goals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82343&key=user_uploads/89898/63e0ef63-8615-4520-b36e-bcabccfdad58)

**tl;dr**

[Intryc](https://intryc.com/) uses AI to automate Quality Assurance for customer support. Customers like [Deel.com](http://deel.com) centralize and automate parts of their Quality Assurance on Intryc to ensure agent compliance, double QA productivity, reduce costs by 50%, and prevent negative customer interactions while collecting actionable product and customer insights.

**The Problem**

Quality assurance for customer support is vital in regulated sectors like banking and utilities. Millions of customer inquiries must be handled and evaluated consistently and accurately to avoid regulatory non-compliance and brand reputation damage. This process is typically run manually by internal teams that still rely on outdated systems or spreadsheets to review and evaluate customer interactions. Even the most efficient QA teams can evaluate less than 5% of total tickets, leaving millions of interactions unreviewed and risking regulatory compliance, reputation damage, and increased customer churn.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82343&key=user_uploads/1341483/44a793a2-2c70-4389-ab09-8970eaaf7e7a)

**The Solution**

Intryc’s AI-powered solution automates the manual, repetitive, and error-prone tasks of the QA process, integrates with knowledge bases and data sources, such as help desks and CRM systems, to streamline the entire process end-to-end and allows organisations to scale their Support QA, without the scaling costs!

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqIx1bnzEGk>

**What Intryc offers:**

* **Automated Intelligent Sampling**
  * Automate your sampling and workload distribution to ensure an optimal ratio of QA specialists to sampled tickets, minimising idle QA time.
  * Create targeted customer ticket samples with AI based on sentiment, keywords, or other custom rules.
* **Dynamic Workload Distribution**
  * Create hybrid or fully automated AI evaluation workloads to double your team’s productivity.
* **Custom Scorecards and Unlimited Coverage**
  * Optimize your scorecards with customized criteria based on internal playbooks, knowledge bases, or evaluation repositories.
  * Score up to 100% of your tickets with AI without a single human involved, or try AI vs human A/B testing, and override AI evaluations when required.
  * Get AI-generated ticket and agent evaluation summaries.
* **Tailored Agent Coaching**
  * Get AI-generated summaries of underperforming agents based on scorecard ratings and provide tailored coaching to each agent.
* **Extensive reporting**
  * AI generated insights based on key topics, product areas, or customer service from your entire ticket base.
  * Real-time ticket evaluations and agent performance summaries for management.

**👋 Ask: How you can help**

* Support us on [here](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intryc/) on socials!
* Connect us to COOs or Customer Support/Experience/Operational leaders in your network at [alex@intryc.com](mailto:alex@intryc.com).
* Give us product feedback as a company leader who cares about their customers’ experience and supports the team’s performance. Book a 15-minute demo [here](https://www.calendly.com/alexmarantel).

**💥 The Deal**

Inbound from the YC network will get a 50% discount. Email [alex@intryc.com](mailto:alex@intryc.com) to redeem the deal!

\

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/7d84f9c1-3d35-4e71-b359-162168ae0cae)

_Founders left to right: Tyler Postle (CEO), Alex Rudolph (CTO)_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/6f2ad306-cb84-4b1d-9b7a-a8ae6ae9f054)

If you are building an agentic product with usage growing rapidly...

* Scanning traces doesn't tell you if agents are helpful, accurate, or hitting walls. You only find out when customers complain or attrition skyrockets.
* Every stakeholder needs data. Every request pulls engineers away from building. Nobody can self-serve insights.
* Product and business teams need to quantify the impact of their AI investments. You have usage stats, but your team is struggling to connect agent performance to conversion, retention, or revenue.

## 🎉 The Solution: Agent Analytics

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/8bbbfd52-25aa-43db-aab0-d75ac050a9a3)

* PMs, analysts, and business teams get digestible insights they need without tickets, bottlenecks, or delays.
* Track what AI agents are saying, identify knowledge gaps, detect abnormalities, and measure improvement over time.
* Connect agent metrics to outcomes that matter by correlating conversational data with user data you’re already collecting.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/b9b51bc2-ecc3-46ba-8820-ec3e81d62db2)

**You shouldn’t have to wait for users to complain** to learn that a recent prompt change is breaking your hotel booking agent, or that the AI finance advisor you built is calling the wrong tool to look up realtime stock prices.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/6a8cd7f8-6e16-4b63-a9a1-ab025f0b0f6e)

### Try for Free!

Install the [Voker SDK](https://app.voker.ai/docs) on our [free tier](https://voker.ai/#pricing) (up to 2,000 events/mo), and start building better agents today: <https://voker.ai/>

name: Capitol AI
long_description:
Capitol AI is building a sovereign operating system for intelligence, designed for regulated, high-stakes institutions such as professional services firms, financial services, and government agencies. These organizations are overwhelmed by data and experimenting with generic AI tools that lack auditability, repeatability, and secure deployment. As a result, critical decisions are increasingly shaped by systems they do not fully control.

Capitol runs entirely inside enterprise infrastructure and transforms proprietary data into structured, decision-grade artifacts such as due diligence reports, regulatory documentation, and executive intelligence. The platform is model-agnostic, fully auditable, and operates with no data egress, giving institutions durable control over their data, workflows, and standards.
one_liner: Capitol: the sovereign operating system for intelligence.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: Brian Chesky encouraged us to apply. He hired Shaun at Airbnb. We wish we had done it earlier, but in some ways, the timing of this couldn’t be better. Brian believes the position we are in is very similar to Airbnb's right before they joined YC. And even similar dynamics to when Justin Kan made the last-minute referral for Airbnb’s founders (Brian, Joe, and Nate) to join YC. Going through the batch has been an incredible experience. Garry, Ooshma, and Aaron are phenomenal partners to work with and boil down opportunities and challenges to overcome to their essence. We’ve made huge strides in the batch regarding product velocity and customer acquisition. We’ve signed a $1.3m customer term sheet with one of the most influential media brands during YC!

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Tom and I were collaborating on Covid-19 logistics applications leveraging AI models for HHS and the US DoD and the interfaces that prime USG integrators like IBM, SAP, and Deloitte produced were unusable. We saw an opportunity to develop integration and design standards for creating intelligent content leveraging models, and Capitol AI was born. We started the company with a contract from the 2nd largest health insurer in the US to automate data storytelling for their self-insured employer business line. We approached this problem with a mix of classical and bayesian statistical analysis and automating insight generation leveraging DBT. After GPT 3.5 was released we saw an opportunity to center our product stack around LLMs. We made a pivot away from healthcare and so that we could collect user data and feedback to move the product forward as quickly as possible. We now have built a product that is in high demand we just closed a $1.3m enterprise contract, with more to come.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: In the future, all content and data publishers will have an AI research layer. Capitol will be the category-defining product that unlocks this transformation, creating a more useful and personalized internet.

launches.tagline: The all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Kashyab and Rishi, co-founders of Verbiflow 😁

# tl;dr

Verbiflow is the all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process. Capture leads with intelligent prospecting that identifies high-potential prospects based on real-time events and smart scheduling & routing that instantly assigns those leads to the best-suited sales rep. Manage your pipeline with complete flexibility, defining and tracking custom KPIs across all your sales interactions. Automate reminders and workflows to keep deals moving forward, all within a single, unified platform.

**Ask:** warm intros to sales leaders 😇 (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)

<https://youtu.be/0jZayvEkiI4>

# The Problem 👎

Sales teams are grappling with inefficiencies that plague every step of the sales process, from chasing down leads to sealing the deal. For sales reps, the clock is their enemy: they spend just 35% of their time actually selling, leaving about 6.5 hours a day tangled up in manual chores like data entry, prospect hunting, call logging, and scheduling follow-ups. This time sink costs companies roughly $68,000 per rep each year in lost productivity—like paying for a chef who spends most of their shift washing dishes instead of cooking. It’s not just money down the drain; it’s missed chances, too. Leads are 9x more likely to turn into customers if contacted within 5 minutes, but reps buried under admin work can’t keep up, letting golden opportunities slip away.

Account Executives (AEs) are under pressure to close complex deals, but they’re stuck piecing together past interactions from scattered emails, linkedin messages, notes, and tools to get full context on a deal. This chaos makes it nearly impossible to remember key discussions or spot issues threatening the deal like price objections or competitor mentions early enough to act. AEs lack the real-time insights to tackle blockers as such head-on. Meanwhile, they’re bogged down tracking multiple deals across clunky, disconnected systems, while needing to manually update them too. To top it off, deals often land with the wrong AE—like asking a barber to fix your car; they’re skilled with scissors, not engines, and your car’s not going anywhere fast. Win rates tank, and growth goals slip out of reach.

**The outcome?** A frustrated sales team that’s overworked, stretched thin, and underdelivering on the company’s revenue goals.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfsJ9u8AMu5T7GayrI8W-Tj0Tcjadt4A_-xcLxSh-k5kba2Es3uSw9_DWUEHGX4U8X7shcpXwSdLexdlKMBRZl9IYAZLtts1nNR52_7WCMkBvsAT2uVP8vSz3uW34dz6QA6wxTwnw?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

# Our Solution 🤩

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/5e2c41a3-b5c3-4a66-9342-21d027cba0b0)

**Time Wasted on Manual Tasks** \
Verbiflow automates lead identification, data enrichment, scheduling, and pulls in all your sales interactions. This eliminates the repetitive manual work that eats up 6.5 hours of a rep’s day, letting them focus purely on selling.

**Missed Opportunities and Poor Deal Assignment**\
Verbiflow ensures leads are contacted instantly with automated follow-ups—hitting the 5-minute window when conversions are 9x more likely—while smart routing matches those deals to the best-suited AE based on expertise and performance history. This keeps opportunities alive and optimally assigned without manual effort or guesswork.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87898&key=user_uploads/2368054/e5ba9f9e-6e63-423c-b61a-3414151bf03a)

**Lack of Centralized Context** \
A unified pipeline consolidates all deal-related emails, messages, calls, & notes, into one view. AEs get a full picture instantly, without digging through scattered sources.

**Sales Blockers**\
AI-powered KPIs flag specific hurdles—like pricing objections, competitor mentions, or price consciousness—giving AEs precise insights to resolve issues quickly.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeog_b3ymaSnvHZeJ97Ybp1ql3WqyZwPQBkRwiZyOl5IajGnwuEgU3HTSxbQIH64diOOKnwFsiCQGa5-39n0lKEfs-GEdFzu8tKR-ycfu_tJTVEqnm1J-mxcqIn5Pywph6_ZS-WqQ?key=9M7pNCNH6ZN22VTOIZDfTMsS)

launches.title: Weave: AI to quantify engineering work
launches.tagline: Engineering metrics for the AI era
launches.body:
tl;dr: Weave uses AI to measure software engineering work in the AI era.

It shows how much work is being done, how much is done by AI and where you can utilize AI tools to improve your engineering process.

### **The Problem**

Historically, it’s been impossible to measure engineering so leaders are left flying blind. Engineering teams rely on gut feel or shoddy metrics to try to get a handle on what’s going on and where to improve.

That's why we built Weave.

### The Solution

https://youtu.be/GkZv9-YZTKI

Weave uses AI to measure engineering work. We run LLMs and our own models on every PR and review, analyzing both output and quality. We integrate with all AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) and have PR level code attribution to determine what was written by AI, what wasn’t, and what should’ve been.

We summarize this data and insights in dashboards. Teams like Reducto, Superpower and Laurel use Weave to ship 16% more, just 2 months after using Weave.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/966b7f89-b6a1-4aa7-8fbc-4b6cd7bf4fb1)


### AI Usage

We show you who your top AI performers are (so they can share best practices), how the team stacks up against its competitors and the real financial return of your AI investments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/57dfeddd-0c9f-49c1-afea-0454bad3f0ab)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/56c25bbf-a333-4bea-9938-93e639687d12)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/c2672d3e-b073-45d1-95d8-41578f1a829d)

### AI Insights

We keep you up to date with the best practices and tools used by the most forward-thinking AI teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/d438efd0-4a9b-41a2-a4ae-1d506e800595)

### Measuring Code Output

This isn't a line of code calculator, this is an actual estimate of our key metric, a Weave Hour: "How long would it take an experienced engineer to make this change?"

We can also tell you how much time each engineer is spending on code review and how helpful their reviews are:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/581a3928-2eb3-4e98-a0d4-e8ae64c6cd15)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/ede5f44c-ca77-4d4c-ab23-12d7c3c6df7f)

### Individual

See output across individuals to identify top performers, see how new hires are ramping and if anyone is blocked.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/1938955/65664616-047f-4ce7-829c-b40839f34d09)

### **Our Story**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87406&key=user_uploads/2077133/d1883e57-85cd-4616-a456-3370a1a0b664)

Adam’s background is in operations and sales. He led organizations of 100+ people and created an internal tool to measure performance and help individuals identify their weak spots. This is common practice in revenue teams and he wants to bring it to engineering.

Andrew was employee #1 at Causal. He saw firsthand how subjective engineering management is and how hard it is to scale a high-performing engineering team.

We met at Causal, where Adam was hired to run the sales and customer success function. We got to talking about the big difference between how our two departments worked, and the rest is history.

**Early Use Cases**

* Reducto, Superpower, and Posthog have used Weave to see increases in output correlated with AI usage (16% on average)
* A manager noticed that code review quality has the highest correlation to output. He reset code review standards and team output went up by 15%
* Smaller engineering teams (\~5 engineers) are using the platform daily in stand-ups

**Our Ask**

* Are you running an engineering team of any size? You can connect your repo to Weave and get started in \~30 seconds [**here**](https://workweave.dev/).
* Do you know any engineering leaders at mid-market or enterprise companies who might find this valuable? We'd love an intro if you do.
* Follow us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/weave-dev) and X!

launches.title: Roark - The Observability & Testing Platform for Voice AI
launches.tagline: Replay real production calls against your latest agent changes, catch failures, and track sentiment.
launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

Roark is an observability and testing platform for Voice AI that shows you whether your agent meets its goals, tracks how customers feel, and lets you replay real calls on your latest changes.

If you’re building voice AI agents and want a faster, smarter way to test and improve them, we’d love to connect! Email [james@roark.ai](mailto:james@roark.ai) or [book a time here](https://calendly.com/james-roark/book-a-demo).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87658&key=user_uploads/91038/0caf0c5a-2421-4fcf-8b6a-2867de8d581f)

_(Replay real calls without picking up the phone.)_

## **The Problem: Testing Voice AI Is Painfully Manual**

Once a voice agent is live, teams have no easy way to test updates. Every time you tweak a prompt or logic, you have to manually call the bot, hoping to catch issues before customers do.

* Does the agent follow the right flow? You don’t know unless you re-run conversations by hand.
* Did a change break something? You won’t find out until users complain.
* How do customers actually experience the bot? Traditional testing tools only analyze text transcripts, missing tone, hesitation, or frustration.

Voice AI teams, especially in healthcare, legal, and customer support need real-world validation for every change they ship. But existing testing tools rely on scripted test cases that don’t reflect real interactions, leading to blind spots and regressions.

## **The Solution**

Roark lets you replay real production calls against your newest AI logic, so you can test changes before they go live. No more manually dialing your bot or relying on outdated scripted tests - get real-world validation instantly.

How It Works:

1. Capture real-world calls: Automatically ingest production conversations from your existing voice AI setup (integrates seamlessly with VAPI, Retell, or custom APIs).
2. Replay calls on your updated agent: Our system re-runs the same user inputs, sentiment, and tone against your latest agent, cloning the original caller’s voice for more realistic testing.
3. Evaluate goal completion: Define key objectives (e.g., “Did the agent confirm insurance?”) and automatically flag failures or missteps.
4. Monitor sentiment & vocal cues: Detect frustration, long pauses, sighs, and hesitation - signals that text-based evaluations miss.
5. Track performance with reports & dashboards: Visualize conversation flows, track drop-offs, and measure key metrics with Mixpanel-style analytics.
6. Get real-time alerts: Set up custom monitoring for compliance violations, negative sentiment spikes, or repeated failures.

Roark gives AI teams the same confidence in testing, iteration, and monitoring that software engineers had for years with modern dev tools.

Check out our demo below!

<https://youtu.be/eu8mo28LsTc?feature=shared>

## **Why We Built Roark**

We first ran into this problem while building a voice agent for a dental clinic. Patients kept reporting issues, getting stuck in loops, failing to confirm insurance, or receiving irrelevant responses. But the only way to test fixes was to call the bot ourselves or read through hundreds of transcripts, hoping to spot patterns. It was frustrating, slow, and unreliable.

After talking to other teams working on Voice AI, we realized this problem was universal - everyone was struggling to validate their AI’s performance efficiently. That’s when we decided to build Roark.

## **Team**

We’re engineers who have built and scaled complex systems at high-growth companies:

James Zammit (CEO) – Infra and AI engineer with 10+ years of experience. Previously at AngelList, where he worked on core infrastructure as the company scaled from $10B to $124B in assets under management and led the development of Relay, an AI-powered portfolio manager. Co-founded three startups, one of which partnered with Firebase and was showcased at Google I/O 2016.

Daniel Gauci (CTO) – Software engineer with 10+ years of experience. Previously at Akiflow (YC S20) as part of the mobile development team, helping the company reach $1.5M ARR and 10,000+ customers. Spent 7 years at Casumo, leading the development of the mobile app used by millions of players helping the company reach $50M+ ARR.

## **Try it out!**

If your team is tired of manually testing voice AI updates and wants a faster, more reliable way to validate changes, email us at [founders@roark.ai](mailto:founders@roark.ai) or [book a demo here](https://calendly.com/james-roark/book-a-demo) - we’d love for you to try out Roark.

Using your go-to AI chat or coding agent for data analysis is great until you want to set up a recurring report or collaborate with your team.

We built an analytics layer for your favorite AI tools to generate hosted reports and live dashboards.

Get started in minutes, for free at [app.bitboard.work](http://app.bitboard.work)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100824&key=user_uploads/2002154/615b65c7-eb00-480f-ba27-cceabe248a50)

**Problem**

The most capable AI tools still treat data analysis as ephemeral, making durable reporting and collaboration a nightmare.

Legacy BI tools weren’t intended for AI users, so they bolt on clumsy chatbots and can’t offer meaningful control to the agents you’re actually using.

**How BitBoard works**

Connect your preferred AI chat or coding agent to BitBoard to build living dashboards and analysis you can share with your team. BitBoard works with any MCP client, including Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

Hosted workbooks let your agent pull data, build visualizations, and add commentary by writing SQL, code, and markdown that’s stored and executed within the workbook.

Work in BitBoard is traceable and repeatable. Logic and outputs are persisted and named so context isn't lost in chat threads or terminals.

Analysis stays fast and cheap as the workbook grows. Small queries stay local, results are cached until the underlying data changes, and your warehouse only returns the rows each query needs.

**Connecting your data**

Want to get started with minimal setup? Just push data from your agent to piggyback off of your agent’s existing connections and we’ll host it.

For ongoing access to live data, securely connect to your apps, databases, and data warehouse from a single point in BitBoard.

**Onboard in minutes, for free**

1. Connect your AI chat or coding agent to BitBoard via MCP. Works with any MCP client, including Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
2. Push data from your agent. We'll host it, no setup required.
3. When you want live data, configure connections to your apps, databases, and warehouse from a single point in BitBoard.

Try pointing your agent at BitBoard for your next KPI review, product analytics investigation, or post-mortem.

Data is the new oil and you're feeding your products with a bunch of it. But to do so, you need to build, maintain, and optimize your data infra. That's either a huge timesink, or you're bleeding cash to ignore it, or someone is breathing down your neck about this month's cloud bill. Why can't we just ship features?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/419acb3d-1195-4842-a80e-df02ac0d332f)

Whether it's those 20-minute+ Presto queries, or your exploding BigQuery bill (which happens to be tracked in real time), your data infra is letting you down.

# **Our Solution**

ParaQuery runs on highly-parallel, throughput-optimized cloud-available hardware, perfect for data processing workloads: **GPUs**!

Our system abstracts out the infra required to serverlessly accelerate your logic. With the extreme efficiency of GPUs, it's half the cost and double the performance of competing solutions like Databricks and BigQuery, without any platform commitments.

For SQL-based data warehouses like BigQuery, you can use ParaQuery with minimal changes to your queries. And since it's fully Spark-compatible, there's no vendor lock-in. It integrates with literally anything which has a Spark connector, on any major cloud. We can even deploy on GPU clouds.

ParaQuery makes data processing as simple as specifying:

1. Inputs
2. Output
3. Logic
4. Run!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/a6cded39-2da7-432b-9129-014a593caaae)

# **Why?**

I've been looking into GPUs and parallel programming for over 12 years – starting out with crypto. I left that field pretty fast, but I never stopped thinking about efficient compute and GPU acceleration. Even more so when, years later, I had to wait for my laptop to finish 18-hour physics simulations. And during my professional career, I've also had to wait on my fair share of 20-minute+ analytical queries.

In fact, I hate waiting. ParaQuery is productizing an arbitrage of hardware efficiency, and I'm not waiting any longer to do so.

# **Ask**

1\. If you know anyone who is running any big data processing scenarios (including MLOps), I'd love to learn more about their use case and see if we're a fit! 

2\. If you want to try it out, sign up for our waitlist at [www.paraquery.com](http://www.paraquery.com), or just email me ([win@paraquery.com](mailto:win@paraquery.com))

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Paloma unifies contracts, service consumption, and customer relationship context so that revenue, success and sales teams can operate from the same ground truth. With everything centralized, you can stay ahead of upsell and churn signals while billing runs smoothly in the background.

https://youtu.be/jav-7qS-S4U

---

### **The Problem**

Fragmented customer context and manual billing kill revenue potential:

* Account managers and customer success don’t have full visibility on which clients to pay attention to for maximizing upsells and minimizing churn
* Complex pricing or custom deals often require manual work to bill accurately, making them hard to support and creating a real barrier to selling

### The Result

* Revenue opportunities slip through the cracks because signals for upsell or renewals aren’t surfaced on time
* Teams don’t have a clear view of what they can upsell or at what price, leading to missed opportunities
* Sales is constrained to “billable” terms, creating friction and slowing execution

The result is a reactive, fragmented go-to-market motion where growth is capped by operational bottlenecks instead of driven by customer opportunity.

---

### **How Paloma Solves It**

Paloma is the AI copilot and system of record for everything that happens after the handshake:

* **Unified ground truth:** Parses contracts, communications, notes and service consumption into one shared customer context for revops, finance and customer success.
* **Surfaces revenue opportunities:** Flags upsells, renewals, churn risks, and usage changes and prioritizes them by impact.
* **Automates billing workflows:** Turns complex terms into billing-ready instructions that run behind the scenes.
* **Works with your stack:** Seamlessly integrates with your CRM, billing software, and data sources to sync context and actions.
* **Human-in-the-loop by design:** You stay in control. Paloma learns from your feedback and gradually automates more over time.

### Demo: From Contract to Invoice in Seconds

**1. Upload Contract & Add Notes**\
Easily import customer contracts and attach important context in seconds.

![Effortless Billing and Invoicing 💻](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXenCXn3XWc-aJ86auvk1b4EbfYkrX83Tacb9LElt6_O29CrmLlKpIV3-g3t-A_ZoEwNMRTLizwutLePHZd6OQoxoJBYoBENxRAEhjZ5StRPdrED7L42JfBVZGDrxzT9GZLvY1NwDg?key=BG5KxR_KYqp8AhZRK2bQPQ)

**2. Parse & Review Contract Data**\
Paloma extracts terms, pricing, and key conditions from the contract.

![Effortless Billing and Invoicing 💻](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcWyfWU9QpLWYr70cBoUZtfs1pqaC4uSNPLA-zF3eCa0zgAMZLXcOxQTZ2EZs-Gl2GMEaTMcyt7oDKcETvRgggs25ZpNHVSVuz0kxx3aHVqSeVKSJplYcr7lpgKw4Dxd0iAc23LpQ?key=BG5KxR_KYqp8AhZRK2bQPQ)

**3. Upload Usage Data**\
Feed in real consumption data to trigger accurate billing calculations.

![Effortless Billing and Invoicing 💻](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXczxqONAnGu0BAaL8dL5EZ8zABzWHQyDBgMN8xgW4YBFvyu7vGKcgBTcBK9s9JNdLqq4ekGPJGVjCCO7KWRvTtxm9x9dR0n4QoPnD5qaQSj188gQ4fMT0A6QwRymziy0-VI-kXY?key=BG5KxR_KYqp8AhZRK2bQPQ)

Watch the system apply contract rules and usage to produce the final invoice, automatically.

Nobody on the team can read every conversation once an agent is in production. TCC does, and turns them into patterns tied to the accounts they affect: where customers get stuck, what they wish the agent could do, and where it's spending more than it needs to.

Engineers ask about a pattern from their IDE through our MCP, get the conversations and traces behind it down to the tool call or prompt that went wrong, ship the fix, and benchmark cost and quality before and after. Product sees what customers are actually trying to do with the agent and where it falls short, broken out by topic and account, which becomes the backlog for what to build next. Customer success sees which accounts the agent is struggling with before the customer says anything, and steps in with the full conversation on hand.

Any agent framework, a few lines of code. If you're running an agent in production or about to launch, ping us.

launches.body:
What is up! We’re [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankumaraswamy/) and [Rohil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohil-ag/) - cofounders of [The Context Company](https://thecontextcompany.com)

**TL;DR**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/129e5656-94c6-42e6-a2ba-6ac545b0ef94)

Setup takes under 10 lines of code, and we now support Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph, with more frameworks coming fast.

**Our Ask**

* If you’re building with Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or LangGraph, use The Context Company for observability.
* Setup takes just a few lines - DM us on Bookface or Slack, or email [founders@thecontextcompany.com](https://mailto:founders@thecontextcompany.com), and we’ll personally onboard you in 15 minutes.
* Not using those frameworks yet? Tell us what you’re building with, and we’ll add support fast.

<https://youtu.be/5FVesVO9egg>

**The Problem**

AI agents often fail quietly. Traditional observability tools only show latency or stack traces. They miss the silent layer of failures that happen inside reasoning steps or tool calls.

Most teams end up waiting until users report issues, and by then, it’s already too late. As a developer, I know you’ve been there scrolling through endless logs, trying to piece together what an agent actually did and why it failed (because trust us, we have too 🙏🏽).

**We’re rethinking observability from the ground up and making silent failures a first-class primitive in agent monitoring.**

\*\*Our Solution:\*\*\
Instead of just visualizing traces, we analyze them and detect reasoning breakdowns across runs. In addition to traditional metrics like latency, cost, and token usage, The Context Company surfaces failures in a clean, developer-friendly dashboard.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/861e36d0-5a8b-4555-a738-e2489729f99f)

And we’ve gone beyond the cloud:

You can now run our developer package locally to debug traces on your machine, even when you’re offline or iterating fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/b7722f3f-a018-4c46-806c-7ef4be35bd44)

**Our Progress**

* Framework support: Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Instant setup: <10 lines of code - no refactoring or modifying your agent needed. This is what it looks like:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/560baa96-5818-4d20-bf82-43f2d3775ca3)

* Local debugging: Run observability locally on your laptop for real-time trace analysis.
* Dashboards: Full visibility into agent runs, tool calls, latency, costs, and semantic failures.

**The Team**\
Arman and Rohil have been best friends since 6th grade (8+ years now!). 

Arman optimized the public-facing AI agent at Mintlify, where he cut failure rates by 82%, and worked with enterprise design partners to build custom agents. Rohil worked on Gmail Intelligence at Google, reducing hallucinations in intent detection by 27% across 26B+ daily emails.

launches.body:
Hello everyone! We’re [Anish](https://x.com/_anishgupta_) and [Marc](https://x.com/marczog), the Co-Founders of PlayVision!\
\
**TL;DR:** PlayVision lets basketball teams automatically analyze their practices and games to get advanced stats on their players, opponents, and college or high school recruits. We use AI and computer vision to get insights based on their tracking data.

https://youtu.be/MZynlUcUdeU

\
**The Problem**:

❌ Coaches spend over **75%** of their week watching film and manually tagging different stats.

❌ College Teams spend **$250K+** on services like HUDL, Synergy, HDI, and other different products just to watch film and scout players.

❌ There are up to **25x** more coaches between teams across Division 1 basketball — most programs lack the man-power to watch the same amount of film and create a comprehensive game-plan.

❌ College athletes are now able to get paid via their Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL). Teams are scrambling trying to figure out how much players are worth.\
\
**Our Solution**:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/425a0c3f-1d4d-4e7d-a46e-241f9655aa11)

An interactive platform that lets coaches upload their film and get the insights they want. We track every player, every movement, every decision made on the court. 

With our database, we also feature:

🏀 Our algorithms that rank every player in the country over the last **10** years.

🏀 Custom indexes where teams leverage over **40** metrics to create their own stats to rank players.

🏀 Automated scouting reports that give coaches **10x** the insights on their players and opponents in **10%** of the time.\
\
**Our Story:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/4ec6f501-bfc9-4758-81e5-910ce716dcc0)

\
I, Anish, was a massive sports fan growing up. I couldn’t play college athletics due to an eye surgery, so I joined Cal Athletics as a scout. I saw first-hand how tedious the manual film analysis was, having to stay late in the office with coaches trying to finish the games we set out to do.

The timing couldn't have been better. Marc, fresh from two years of AI and computer vision research at the Mayo Clinic, happened to be in my AI in SportsTech class at Berkeley. I pitched him my problem, and within minutes, we were deep in discussion about how AI and computer vision could crack it.

Leveraging my connections in the college space, we started getting validation from coaches, expressing the same pain points I had. We’ve partnered with teams from the SEC, BIG 10, and BIG EAST conferences, and you could be next!

**Our Ask**:

👉 Our product is now live for the 2025-2026 basketball season. If you know anyone that works for a college, NBA, or international basketball team that would be interested, please reach out via email: [team@withplayvision.ai](mailto:team@withplayvision.ai)!

👉 If you’re interested in getting data on your favorite players, sign up for our player portal on our website: https://withplayvision.ai/ \
\
Reach us:

* https://www.linkedin.com/in/anishjaygupta/
* https://www.linkedin.com/in/marc-zoghby/

launches.title: Lemma: Continuous Learning for AI Agents
launches.tagline: We enable AI agents to continuously improve by turning real user feedback into automated prompt optimizations.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

Lemma is the first evaluation + observability platform built not just to measure performance, but to improve it automatically. We help AI agents learn from real user feedback and production data, closing the loop so your prompts and agents continuously optimize themselves over time.

**Launch Video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E4_v-pY_4fs

Hey everyone! We’re [Jerry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerry-n-zhang/) and [Cole](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colegawin/), co-founders of [Lemma](https://www.uselemma.ai/) (YC F25).

**The Problem:**

**AI agents don’t learn from their mistakes. In fact, they get worse with use.**

In production, prompts and agents continuously degrade due to real-world input drift (new user behaviors or unseen edge cases). Agent performance can often **drop \~40% in a few weeks**, and suddenly what worked in testing breaks in front of customers.

When that happens, engineers are forced to dig through logs, collect failing examples, and manually tweak prompts rather than building core product features.

**Solution:**

That’s why we built **Lemma: the first end-to-end system that closes the loop between agent deployment and improvement.**

**Here's what that means:**

**Step 1:** Lemma detects failed outcomes directly from live traffic, and it automatically identifies the exact cause in an agent chain.

**Step 2:** Lemma alerts you, and with one click, it runs targeted prompt optimizations to fix the failing behavior without any manual tracing or guesswork.

**Step 3:** We give you back an improved prompt and automatically open a PR in your codebase so your prompts can live where you want them. Alternatively, you can also fetch your prompt from the Lemma dashboard.

**Plus, Lemma provides all the LLM eval and observability features you rely on, just reimagined for continuous learning:**

* Data-ingestion pipeline to bring your existing eval sets and automatically flag inconsistencies and gaps

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95219&key=user_uploads/1798805/4f862c09-dce0-48da-91fe-1a152a5d82da)

* Prompt editor and inference support for any closed & open-source model for prompt iteration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95219&key=user_uploads/1798805/92464a28-ab54-4511-bc79-fd3e4f9d4823)

* Agent tracing observability with live drift detection, regression alerts, and performance visibility across real user interactions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95219&key=user_uploads/1798805/2b82ecee-1965-4fc0-831d-36b76db3f064)

Teams using Lemma cut manual prompt iteration by 90%, resolve production drifts in minutes instead of days, and improve model performance \~2–5% every optimization cycle.

**Our Story:**

We met freshman year at USC and have been building together ever since instead of going to classes.

Before starting Lemma, we were engineers at two high growth, AI-native startups: Tandem (AI for healthcare) and Chipstack (AI agents for chip design). At both companies, setting up evaluations looked like clunky Retool dashboards and multiple engineers manually tweaking experiments. We built internal systems that automated both running the evaluations themselves, as well as the error-driven feedback loop. The result: 2x accuracy improvement and speed of iteration.

We soon realized every AI company was reinventing the same internal tooling in-house. So we left college, joined YC, and are now bringing continuous learning infrastructure to everyone else.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95219&key=user_uploads/1798805/53754495-215a-47aa-884d-bae4a59f9a68)

**Ask**

**Try our platform** - If you’re building with LLMs and run a ton of prompt or eval experiments, we’d love for you to work with us.

**Introductions** - If you know a Head of AI/Eng or CTO at a pre-seed to Series A startup, we owe you lunch :)

Please reach out at [jerry@uselemma.ai](mailto:jerry@uselemma.ai) or book a live demo on our website [uselemma.ai](http://uselemma.ai). All help is appreciated - thank you!

launches.title: Studio: The simulation engine for market behavior
launches.tagline: The first accurate simulation models able to predict society's response to an idea.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies interact with new ideas, and building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected consumer segments from real behavior data. Studio's predictions match live KPI outcomes like revenue and sentiment with over 95% accuracy.

<https://youtu.be/g0M-T2ohtcQ>

## The problem

A huge number of consequential decisions are bets on human behavior.

A company launches a product or changes a price. A brand runs a campaign. A public institution launches a new initiative or communications strategy. In each case, the outcome depends on how a population responds.

Today, teams rely on surveys and historical data to help derisk those bets.

But those tools are inherently outdated and non-comprehensive: they observe people individually and at a point in time.

_Real populations don’t behave that way._

People influence one another. Reactions spread between groups. Adoption compounds or fades. Sentiment changes. A decision that resonates with one audience can change how another audience responds. Those interactions are what ultimately determine outcomes like revenue, conversion, adoption, and sentiment.

Currently, the only real “simulation” is the launch itself.

## What we do

Studio builds live models of a company’s market from real data on how consumers behave. It overlays internal data like sales and campaign performance with external evidence like social conversations and market trends.

Studio uses those signals to construct highly specific audience cohorts and model how their behavior and influence interact over time.

Teams can then:

* **Test-run launches:** see how a new product, price, campaign, message, or initiative will unfold.
* **Forecast outcomes:** revenue, conversion, adoption, sentiment, and other KPIs.
* **Understand why:** know which groups drive the result, by how much, and trace outcomes to exact evidence.
* **Test alternatives:** compare different versions of a decision to find the optimal variation.
* **Improve over time:** compare forecasts with real outcomes and recalibrate the model.

Instead of predicting “How will this person respond to X?”, Studio answers:

“How will a population interact with X, and why?”

Studio has live-tested with large consumer brands like Danone and Mila, and our model’s predictions match real-world KPI outcomes with >95% accuracy.

## Why we built it

We’ve spent years predicting behavior. Nikita built simulation software to understand and predict individual decision-making at MIT, while Cameron built predictive models for financial institutions and in private equity, and agent-based society simulations at UC Berkeley MET.

We met at the same gap: you can simulate how a protein will fold or how a financial system will react to a market shock, but there is no equivalent for simulating how society will interact with a new idea. We’re now creating a studio to design society.

## Where we’re starting

We’re initially working with enterprises making high-stakes audience-facing decisions across product, pricing, innovation, brand, marketing, and communications.

But the underlying problem is much broader.

Any organization trying to create a particular response in a population should be able to test different versions of that decision, understand how reactions might spread, and compare likely outcomes before deploying it.

## Our ask

We’d love to talk to teams making consumer-facing decisions. This could be a new product, pricing plan, campaign, etc.

If you have an upcoming decision you’d like to test before it goes live, we’d love to run it through Studio!
